description: This file defines a simple Qt6 application with a custom widget displaying welcome messages. It includes a constructor for WelcomeWidget that sets up a vertical layout with two styled labels, and the main function initializes and displays the widget.

classes.name: WelcomeWidget
classes.description: A QWidget-derived class that creates a welcome message interface with styled labels.

methods.name: WelcomeWidget::WelcomeWidget
methods.description: Constructor that sets up the layout and styles for the welcome widget.

methods.name: int main(int argc,char * argv[])
methods.description: Entry point of the application, initializes the QApplication, displays the WelcomeWidget, and starts the event loop.
